verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce documents payment-side protocol calls: purchase-intent mandates (POST /acp/v1/instructions, with cancel), card enrollment, and credential retrieval scoped to merchant and amount. Its Agent Toolkit covers invoices and payment links. None of these is a documented call for an agent to create or update a cart or order draft. These are adjacent payment and billing primitives rather than cart or order-draft management, so they earn no credit here.
